rewritten: 2026年8月华东区的净销额占全国的比例是多少
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY d.year_month, dl.region
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN region = '华东' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(net_sales), 0),
        2
    ) AS 华东区净销额占比
FROM monthly_sales

rewritten: 华南区2026年8月比7月的净销额增长了多少金额
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        dl.region,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE dl.region = '华南'
      AND d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY dl.region, d.year_month
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN year_month = '2026-08' THEN net_sales END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN year_month = '2026-07' THEN net_sales END) AS 净销额增长金额
FROM monthly_sales
